mechanism: Offline-profiled ranking matrix ('Memory module') used to route code generation, debugging and refinement to different LLMs
evidence_scope: The generation, debugging, and refinement agents select models us- ing a Memory module that ranks candidate LLMs by their measured performance for each stage, program- ming language, and algorithmic category.
evidence_role: we propose PerfOrch, a multi-LLM-based multi-agent system consisting of four agents for categorization, generation, debugging, and refinement.
